2610.09772.title: Decoupling Logic from Persona: Structural Immunity of Edge LLM Agents to Context Pollution
2610.09772.paper_summary: Small language-model agents on edge devices must hold a persona and reason correctly at once, inside one context window that fills with conversational history and persona instructions. We study what happens to the logical part of such an agent when that history is long, misleading and persona-heavy (persona-logic interference), and present a Decoupling Architecture (AO-DA) that separates logical inference ("What") from persona expression ("How") into two inference paths on one INT4 base model with hot-swappable LoRA adapters. The logic path receives only the core turn and emits a verifiable structured state (Micro-State); the persona path renders it in character with the full history. In same-base-model ablations on an Apple M2 laptop (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Gemma-3-4B-it, 4-bit; 480 runs over 4 pollution levels x 3 arms x 2 tasks x 2 personas x 5 seeds) we find: (i) the decoupled logic path is structurally invariant to pollution: its prompt stays at 180 (Llama) or 167 (Gemma) tokens while the mixed single-pass prompt grows from 242 to 1,203, and its outputs are byte-identical across levels (40/40); (ii) the mixed single pass degrades monotonically (composite logic score 0.669 to 0.150 on Llama, 0.487 to 0.150 on Gemma), mostly by failing to emit the required structured output (80-95% of runs on Llama, 100% on Gemma at the two highest levels); (iii) with the same pollution fed into the decoupled logic path, the dedicated-adapter, dedicated-format path is still more robust than the single pass on the 8B model (failure 0-20% vs 80-95%; paired $Δ$ +0.30 to +0.50, Cliff's $δ$ 0.50-0.85, Holm-adjusted $p \le 0.03$) but not on the 4B model, where both collapse. Separation costs one extra decode on a topic's first turn (28.2 s vs 18.2 s on Llama) and buys persona hot-swapping in 1.7 ms without re-running the logic path. Code, rubric, fixtures, adapters and logs are released.
2610.09772.paper_summary_zh: 小型語言模型代理在邊緣設備上必須同時擁有個性並正確推理，這一切都發生在一個充滿對話歷史和個性指令的上下文窗口內。我們研究當這些歷史長、具誤導性且以個性為重時（個性邏輯干擾），這樣的代理的邏輯部分會發生什麼變化，並提出了一種解耦架構（AO-DA），將邏輯推理（「什麼」）與個性表達（「如何」）分離成兩條推理路徑，基於一個具有熱插拔LoRA適配器的INT4基礎模型。邏輯路徑僅接收核心回合並發出可驗證的結構狀態（微狀態）；個性路徑則根據完整的歷史將其呈現為角色。在Apple M2筆記本電腦上的相同基礎模型消融實驗（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Gemma-3-4B-it，4位元；480次運行，涵蓋4個污染水平 x 3個臂 x 2個任務 x 2個個性 x 5個隨機種子）中，我們發現：（i）解耦的邏輯路徑在結構上對污染保持不變：其提示保持在180（Llama）或167（Gemma）個標記，而混合單通道提示從242增長到1,203，且其輸出在各個水平上是字節相同的（40/40）；（ii）混合單通道的性能單調下降（Llama的綜合邏輯得分從0.669降至0.150，Gemma從0.487降至0.150），主要是因為未能發出所需的結構化輸出（在Llama上80-95%的運行，Gemma在兩個最高水平上100%）；（iii）在將相同污染輸入到解耦邏輯路徑的情況下，專用適配器、專用格式路徑仍然比8B模型上的單通道更具穩健性（失敗率0-20%對比80-95%；配對$Δ$ +0.30到+0.50，Cliff's $δ$ 0.50-0.85，Holm調整後的$p \le 0.03$），但在4B模型上則不然，兩者均崩潰。分離在主題的第一次回合上需要額外一次解碼（Llama上28.2秒對比18.2秒），並以1.7毫秒的速度實現個性熱插拔，而無需重新運行邏輯路徑。代碼、評分標準、固定裝置、適配器和日誌已發布。
2610.09772.author: Masaaki Nakatsu et.al.
